title: lestx's Rarity Keep
description: Keep only what matters when you die.
body:
**Keep only what matters when you die.**

**RarityKeep** is a lightweight Fabric mod that protects the items you actually care about after death, without turning survival into creative mode.
Instead of keeping everything, it keeps only what matches your rules: rarity, enchanted items, and important customized gear.

Vanilla-friendly. Configurable. Fair.

### ⭐ Features

- Keep items by rarity (UNCOMMON / RARE / EPIC)
  
- Optional: keep enchanted items
  
- Optional: keep customized items (named, trimmed, special data)
  
- Manual Always Keep list (items/tags)
  
- Manual Always Drop list (items/tags)
  
- Per-dimension profiles (Overworld / Nether / End)

### 📦 Dependencies

✅ Required

> Fabric API
> 
> Cloth Config

✅ Recommended

> Mod Menu (for easy in-game configuration)

### 💬 Credits

Created by lestx
Built with Fabric + Cloth Config + Mod Menu

It helps more than you’d think.
